Let (A_{B}) and (A_{C}) be the nine-point circles of A'BC" and A'B"C, resp., and define (B_{C}), (B_{A}), (C_{A}), (C_{B}) cyclically. Let \(R_{A}\) be the radical axis of (B_{C}), (C_{B}), and define \(R_{B}\) and \(R_{C}\) cyclically. The parallels to \(R_{A}\), \(R_{B}\), \(R_{C}\) through A, B, C, resp., concur in X_1994. The parallels to \(R_{A}\), \(R_{B}\), \(R_{C}\) through A", B", C", resp., concur in X_37636. (Randy Hutson, March 29, 2020)
